assignment.consistency: One context and one event are fixed across all six stories for each child.

visualTreatment.scope: context introduction, relationship identity pages, event pages, and helping-choice page
visualTreatment.homeRoom: subtle palette-matched wall; original picture-frame geometry retained while the empty artwork field and frame bars receive a faint palette-matched tint inside fixed masks; abstract picture people removed; lamp, floor, couch, shadows, matched gray pillows, and neutral furniture details protected from tint spill
visualTreatment.schoolRoom: subtle palette-matched wall, inverse neutral classroom rug, and neutral gray desk surfaces
visualTreatment.characterTreatment: original character RGB values and geometry are unchanged; only connected or very large pure-white source-background components are transparent
